info.description: FastAPI service backing mathbank-web, mathbank-live and mathbank-agent. Three auth boundaries: a shared `X-Admin-Api-Key` header (configured via `ADMIN_API_KEY`) for legacy `/v1/admin/*` operations, staff cookies for `/v1/admin/socratic/*` (Cognito by default; explicit loopback-only local testing available), and a learner `Authorization: Bearer` JWT (obtained from `POST /v1/learner/login`) for student-owned operations. Most of `/v1` is anonymous read access. See `documentation/requirements/reference/REST_API.md` for the prose reference and `documentation/requirements/45_REST_API_DOCUMENTATION_AND_ADMIN_CRUD_GAPS.md` for known documentation/CRUD gaps and their tracked fixes.
